description: Bootstrap v3.3.7 Popover plugin implementation extending tooltip.js, defining Popover class, its methods, and jQuery plugin interface.

classes.name: Popover
classes.description: Class implementing popover functionality, extending tooltip.js, with methods for content management and DOM manipulation.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns default options for the Popover instance.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the popover, including title and body, and manages visibility and classes.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the popover has any content (title or body).

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content for the popover, either from data attribute or callback.

methods.name: arrow
methods.description: Returns the arrow element of the popover.
